description: Bounded SQL/behavior corpus executed by both the official CUBRID JDBC driver (JdbcRunner.java) and the public cubrid-client API (ts-runner.ts) against the same live broker. See docs/LEGACY_PARITY.md#official-jdbc-comparison.

intentional.reason: BIGINT is a JavaScript bigint so all 64 bits stay exact; JDBC uses java.lang.Long. Same value. docs/TYPES.md#reading-result-columns
NUMERIC is returned as decimal text, because JavaScript has no decimal type; JDBC uses BigDecimal. Same digits and scale.
DATE is a JavaScript Date (an instant) read in the client's timezone option; JDBC uses java.sql.Date. Compared as wall-clock fields. #113
TIME is a JavaScript Date on 1970-01-01; JDBC uses java.sql.Time. Compared as wall-clock fields. #113
DATETIME and TIMESTAMP are JavaScript Date values; JDBC uses java.sql.Timestamp (driver subclass CUBRIDTimestamp). Compared as wall-clock fields. #113
query() loads complete BLOB content into a Buffer; JDBC returns a locator-backed java.sql.Blob that the runner reads. Same bytes. docs/TYPES.md#blob-and-clob-columns
query() loads complete CLOB content as a string; JDBC returns a locator-backed java.sql.Clob that the runner reads. Same text. docs/TYPES.md#blob-and-clob-columns

expectedDefect.reason: cubrid-client always decodes CHAR/VARCHAR bytes as UTF-8. The CUBRID Docker images create testdb with charset iso88591, so the server stores the UTF-8 bytes that both drivers send (steps 2 and 4 agree on HEX and LENGTH) as iso88591 characters, and JDBC decodes them in that column charset. A byte that is not UTF-8, such as CHR(233), becomes U+FFFD in cubrid-client. Recorded, not fixed, by #118.

cases.unverified: Needs a broker restart or CAS kill between statements; not part of this bounded lane. Covered only by the native integration suite, not compared with JDBC.

Needs fault injection after a statement reaches the server; JDBC and cubrid-client cannot be compared without a proxy. Native behavior is documented in docs/TYPES.md#values-that-cannot-be-decoded and API_REFERENCE error details.
